theater: 色薩利平原與埃庇魯斯山口

battle.name: 第二次馬其頓戰爭
battle.theater: 色薩利平原與埃庇魯斯山口
battle.brief: 公元前200年羅馬撕毀與菲利普五世的休戰，聯同埃托利亞、亞該亞聯盟渡海東進，戰線自德爾維尼河、奧斯山口直抵色薩利，公元前197年於犬首山破其長矛方陣。卡面亞述長弓非本役實物：這件角筋複合弓是東方弓系的祖型，前二百年已傳入地中海，成為同盟弓兵手中射擊方陣側翼的兵器。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 公元前200至197年，交戰的兩邊是羅馬共和國與馬其頓王國，而雙方都不是單一民族的國家：都是以本國公民兵為骨幹，再靠同盟與外族輔兵補成聯盟式的軍團。羅馬方面由兩名執政官分頭統兵，開戰由元老院議決，但戰場上的臨機決斷全交給執政官；軍隊核心是每個兵團約四千五百人的公民步兵，採用「三列縱隊」的古式密集方陣，縱隊之間留出投矛的間隙，全軍輔以數百人編成的騎兵小隊、同盟城邦提供的「同盟軍團」，以及為數不多的外族輔兵。馬其頓方面是安提柯王朝的國王菲利普五世親自執掌，職業常備軍以薩里沙長矛方陣為骨幹，縱深遠超希臘城邦的軍隊，另有輕裝步兵與不披重甲的馬其頓式騎兵，國王的兄弟亞歷山大掌握左翼騎兵，堂弟塞萊庫斯領右翼。菲利普一方的盟國包括埃托利亞聯盟與伊庇魯斯部分勢力；羅馬一方則有亞該亞聯盟、帕加馬的歐塔洛斯二世、羅得島，以及莫羅西亞王亞歷山德羅斯率領的伊庇魯斯。整場戰爭是兩種體系的正面對撞：羅馬勝在兵員補充、騎兵質量與聯盟內部的多線配合，馬其頓勝在方陣的正面衝力與國王的臨場決斷。
countriesEn: From 200 to 197 BC the two belligerents were the Roman Republic and the kingdom of Macedon, and neither was a single-ethnic state: each built an alliance-like host around its own citizen infantry and filled it out with allies and foreign auxiliaries. On the Roman side two consuls held separate commands, the Senate decided the war, but the decision of the moment was left entirely to the consuls in the field; the core was a citizen infantry of about four thousand five hundred men per legion, arrayed in the old three-line manipular formation with gaps left between the lines for the javelins to fly; to this were added cavalry units of a few hundred men each, the ala sociorum contributed by allied communities, and a small number of foreign auxiliaries. On the Macedonian side King Philip V of the Antigonid dynasty commanded in person, his standing army built around the sarissa phalanx with a depth far greater than any Greek city force, backed by light infantry and lightly armoured Macedonian cavalry: the king's brother Alexander held the left wing, his cousin Seleucus the right. Philip's partners included the Aetolian League and parts of Epirus; Rome's partners included the Achaean League, Attalus II of Pergamon, Rhodes, and Epirus under the Molossian king Alexander. The whole war was a head-on collision of two systems: Rome had the edge in manning, in cavalry quality and in the multi-axis cooperation of its allies, Macedon in the shock power of the phalanx and in the king's own decisions on the field.
people: 全場的關鍵人物是幾個：羅馬方面，提比留斯·昆克提烏斯·弗拉米尼努斯是主軸。公元前201年他還只是出使埃托利亞的特使，元老院議決與菲利普和談時，他在演說中主張拒絕、主張解放希臘，此議成為後來開戰的輿論準備；公元前199年他奉命率一萬名援兵赴希臘，接替在德爾維尼河一役雖勝而無力深入的梅魯拉與阿蒂利烏斯；公元前198年他率軍夜行迂迴，強渡奧斯山口，把菲利普逐出埃庇魯斯，逼入色薩利；公元前197年犬首山會戰他以兩翼前突的陣形擊破方陣；公元前196年他在科林斯地峽宣布希臘各邦自由，成為整個地中海世界轟動一時的「解放者」。馬其頓方面是菲利普五世本人：他擅長持久消耗與避戰，卻在犬首山把兵力的最後籌碼押在方陣強攻上而崩盤；其兄亞歷山大的左翼騎兵被擊潰，是全軍崩壞的起點；近臣克拉西亞斯曾力勸夜襲羅馬營地而不被採信，此後又因反對撤退而被處死。希臘方面，亞該亞聯盟的領袖西基翁的阿拉托斯既是羅馬最重要的盟友，也是聯盟內反對與馬其頓和解的關鍵人物；埃托利亞聯盟在戰前是挑起事端的一方，戰後卻因不滿分配而與羅馬漸行漸遠。史家波里比烏斯在《歷史》第六、十八卷記下犬首山的經過，該書同時是今日重建此役兵力與部署的主要依據。
peopleEn: A handful of men carry the weight of this campaign. On the Roman side the axis is Titus Quinctius Flamininus. In 201 BC he was still only an extraordinary envoy to the Aetolian League, and when the Senate debated making terms with Philip he argued in a famous speech for refusal and for the liberation of Greece; that argument became the public preparation for the war. In 199 BC he was sent to Greece with reinforcements of ten thousand men, taking over from Merula and Atilius, who had won the engagement at the river Derveni but lacked the strength to press on. In 198 BC he forced the pass of the Aous by a night march and a turning movement, driving Philip out of Epirus and pressing into Thessaly. In 197 BC at Cynoscephalae he broke the phalanx with a formation whose wings advanced ahead of its centre. In 196 BC he proclaimed the freedom of the Greek cities at the Isthmus of Corinth and became the liberator the whole Mediterranean world talked about. On the Macedonian side was Philip V himself: a master of endurance, of refusing battle, and of husbanding his resources, yet at Cynoscephalae he staked everything on a frontal assault by the phalanx and the formation came apart. His brother Alexander's left-wing cavalry was beaten back, which was where the collapse began. The courtier Cleitus urged a night attack on the Roman camp and was not heard; later he was executed for opposing a withdrawal. Among the Greeks, Aratus of Sicyon, leader of the Achaean League, was Rome's most valuable partner and the man inside the League who opposed making terms with Macedon. The Aetolian League had lit the fire before the war and afterwards grew cool towards Rome over the division of the spoils. The historian Polybius recorded the course of Cynoscephalae in the sixth and eighteenth books of his History, and that work remains the main source for reconstructing the forces and the deployment of this campaign.
kits: 本役的裝備譜系裡，卡面這件亞述長弓並不是前線的實物，而是弓的祖型：公元前700年前後的亞述以角背、筋纏、木胎的複合弓配鐵矛與輕裝戰車，弓兵立於車上射擊、車兵踏著弓兵開出的路前進，兩河流域的攻勢便是這樣推平。同一型制的「角背角」複合弓在波斯與西徐亞一線傳承下來，到公元前2世紀已是地中海世界最普及的弓，敘利亞、克里特、色雷斯與希臘北方的弓手，連同羅馬軍中為數不多的外族弓兵，用的都是這一種。同一場合裡還有：馬其頓的薩里沙長矛，長可達六米有餘、必須雙手握持，瞄準全靠矛身下端的皮帶；方陣步兵配小圓盾與鎧甲，羅馬公民步兵則配大盾 scutum、加重標槍與短劍；埃托利亞的輕裝長矛手與羅得島的投石手；羅馬的攻城塔、投石機與弓弩，以及用來封鎖希臘沿岸馬其頓港口的數十艘五排槳戰艦，另有縱火船與改裝的貨船充作封鎖線的支點。馬匹方面，馬其頓騎兵用色雷斯的輕型小馬配馬鐙甲，羅馬騎兵用較重的馬；補給則靠羅馬自義大利的海運、亞該亞與埃托利亞控制的山道，以及每戰役季重新徵集的糧秣。亞述長弓的位置，就在這張裝備表的最遠端：它提醒人們，羅馬公民軍本身幾乎不用弓，能夠壓制方陣縱深排列的投射武器，全靠同盟與外族帶來的角背複合弓。
kitsEn: Within the order of battle of this war the Assyrian bow on the card was not a front-line artefact but the ancestor of the bow itself: around 700 BC Assyria used composite bows of horn backing, sinew and wood together with iron spears and light chariots, archers shooting from the platform while the chariots advanced along the path the archers opened, and it was in that way the Mesopotamian offensives were carried through. The same 'horn-bone-horn' composite design, transmitted down the Persian and Scythian line, had by the 2nd century BC become the commonest bow in the Mediterranean, used by Syrian, Cretan, Thracian and northern Greek archers, and by the few foreign archers in the Roman army. The same field also held the Macedonian sarissa, over six metres long, requiring both hands, aimed by a leather thong at the base of the shaft; small round shields and body armour for the phalanx infantry, against the big scutum, the heavy pilum and the short sword of the Roman citizen infantry; the javelin-armed light troops of the Aetolians and the slingers of Rhodes; the Roman siege towers, stone-throwers and cheiroballistae, and the several dozen quinqueremes used to blockade Philip's Greek ports, with fire-ships and converted cargo hulls making up the line of the blockade. In horseflesh, Macedonian cavalry rode the small Thracian type with chamfrons and stirrups, Roman cavalry the heavier animal. Supply came by sea from Italy, by the mountain tracks held by the Achaeans and Aetolians, and by grain requisitioned afresh each campaigning season. The place of the Assyrian bow on this list is the far end of it: it reminds us that the Roman citizen army scarcely used bows at all, and that the only missile weapon capable of troubling the depth of a phalanx was the horn-backed composite bow brought in by allies and foreign auxiliaries.
tactics: 犬首山會戰的部署，是羅馬人用七年時間反覆推敲出來的答案。羅馬主力排成兩翼前突、中段後退的凹形，縱隊厚薄不等：菲利普見方陣正面寬廣而縱深不整，遂令全軍沿山脊下坡進攻，試圖用方陣的縱深碾平中段的凹陷。與此同時，羅馬把所有騎兵集中在方陣左翼對面，先以羅馬騎兵與亞該亞騎兵合力擊潰亞歷山大率領的馬其頓左翼騎兵，再乘勝掩殺方陣側翼；菲利普在左翼受挫後下令全軍猛攻，中段縱隊被衝破，方陣縱深遂失去協同。埃托利亞的輕騎趁亂繞到方陣後方，以標槍騷擾並擴大混亂，羅馬步兵則在側翼與後方同時壓上，縱深被切成數段，士卒在丘陵與沼澤間被分割俘虜。這一戰之前的兩個動作同樣關鍵：公元前200年德爾維尼河，羅馬騎兵擊潰馬其頓騎兵，菲利普的海岸封鎖線被打開；公元前198年奧斯山口，弗拉米尼努斯不強攻正面，而是以夜行軍繞過菲利普營地側後，涉水渡河，反過來把馬其頓軍趕出埃庇魯斯。菲利普本人也曾多次避戰，焚燒田禾、遲滯行軍，試圖以時間與縱深拖垮羅馬的海運補給；但羅馬一旦登陸並在色薩利站穩，深攻與消耗都無法救回方陣。值得注意的是，方陣兩翼的薄弱並非無因：方陣一旦在丘陵地形上展開行列，側面就難以互相掩護，這正是投射武器與騎兵最能得手之處，而弓兵與輕步兵在戰前夜裡被集中配置在兩翼高地上，等的正是這個時刻。
tacticsEn: The deployment at Cynoscephalae was the answer the Romans had worked out over seven years of study. The Roman line was drawn as a crescent whose wings ran forward and whose centre fell back, the depth of the columns deliberately unequal: seeing the phalanx broad in front but irregular in depth, Philip ordered his whole army down the ridge in a general assault, hoping the weight of the phalanx would crush the hollowed centre. At the same time the Romans concentrated all their cavalry opposite the left wing of the phalanx, engaging Alexander's Macedonian left with the Roman and Achaean horse together, beating it, and pressing on into the flank. When the left was broken Philip ordered a general attack; the hollow centre was overrun, the depth of the phalanx lost its coordination, and the Aetolian light horse rode round to the rear, harrying with javelins and widening the confusion, while Roman infantry pressed in on flank and rear at once, cutting the depth into segments and taking men prisoner among the hills and marshes. Two earlier moves mattered as much: at the river Derveni in 200 BC Roman cavalry beat the Macedonian horse and opened Philip's coastal blockade; at the Aous in 198 BC Flamininus refused the frontal attack, marched by night round the flank of Philip's camp, forded the river behind him, and turned the Macedonian army out of Epirus. Philip himself repeatedly declined battle, burning crops and delaying his march, trying to starve out the Roman sea supply; but once Rome was landed and established in Thessaly neither deep advance nor delay could save the phalanx. The weakness of the phalanx's flanks was not accidental: once the ranks were extended over broken ground they could no longer cover one another, which was precisely where missile troops and cavalry could profit, and the archers and light infantry had been massed on the heights of both wings the night before, waiting for that moment.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。戰爭歷時三年，跨四個戰役季，自公元前200年渡海至公元前197年犬首山。犬首山一役，據波里比烏斯記載，羅馬方面步兵約二萬、騎兵約二千，此外有亞該亞聯盟騎兵約八百、埃托利亞聯盟輕步兵約五百；馬其頓方面步兵約二萬，其中方陣一萬六千人，另有輕裝步兵，騎兵約三千，分由亞歷山大的左翼二千與塞萊庫斯的右翼一千指揮。同一戰役的損耗，羅馬方面陣亡數百人，馬其頓方面陣亡約八千、被俘約五千。距離方面，自科林斯至色薩利犬首山，行軍約三百公里；羅馬自義大利至希臘的航程，單程約二千公里，糧秣全靠海運。戰前一年，羅馬另派一萬步兵赴希臘接應。戰後和約規定菲利普退出全部希臘領地、不干涉亞該亞聯盟，並在十年內支付一千塔蘭特白銀。羅馬並未在希臘留大軍，只在德米特里亞斯、科林斯與埃布亞的卡爾基斯留下駐軍。需注意這些數字出自波里比烏斯一人的記載，古代戰報多有誇大，兵員數字應作概數看。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The war lasted three years and four campaigning seasons, from the crossing of the sea in 200 BC to Cynoscephalae in 197 BC. At Cynoscephalae Polybius records on the Roman side about twenty thousand foot and two thousand horse, with about eight hundred Achaean cavalry and five hundred Aetolian light infantry besides; on the Macedonian side about twenty thousand foot, of whom sixteen thousand were in the phalanx, with light infantry besides, and about three thousand horse, divided between two thousand under Alexander on the left and one thousand under Seleucus on the right. Casualties in the same battle: several hundred dead on the Roman side, on the Macedonian side about eight thousand killed and five thousand taken prisoner. In terms of distance, the march from Corinth to Cynoscephalae in Thessaly ran to something like three hundred kilometres, while the sea passage from Italy to Greece was about two thousand kilometres each way, with grain moving entirely by water. In the year before the battle Rome sent a further ten thousand infantry to Greece. The settlement after the war required Philip to withdraw from all Greek territory, not to interfere with the Achaean League, and to pay a thousand talents of silver over ten years. Rome kept no large army in Greece, leaving only garrisons at Demetrias, Corinth and Chalcis on Euboea. It should be borne in mind that these numbers rest on the testimony of a single author, Polybius, and ancient despatches tend to inflate; the figures of men should be read as approximations.
cause: 開戰的緣由是多層的。最直接的一層是休戰破裂：第一次馬其頓戰爭之後羅馬與馬其頓訂過和約，而菲利普在第二次布匿戰爭中與漢尼拔結盟，公元前202年羅馬在札馬獲勝後，原本因對迦太基作戰而勉強維持的和平再也維持不下去，羅馬決定趁新仇未消、一鼓作氣解決東方的威脅。第二層是菲利普自己的擴張：他公元前221年即位後先平定佩奧尼亞人的叛亂，接著在公元前220至217年與埃托利亞聯盟開戰，把勢力伸入伊庇魯斯與伯羅奔尼撒，又以捐贈土地、扶植傀儡的方式插手希臘城邦的政治，成為亞該亞與埃托利亞兩方共同的敵人。第三層是希臘方面的請願：公元前201年前後埃托利亞與亞該亞兩方先後遣使赴羅馬，說明菲利普的威脅，羅馬起初猶豫，弗拉米尼努斯的演說才把輿論扭轉。第四層是羅馬自身的戰略需要：布匿戰爭結束，龐大的公民兵與指揮官需要新的戰場，而介入希臘可以讓羅馬以「解放者」的姿態取得道義上的地盤，不必背上侵略者的名號。至於「解放希臘」的口號本身，既是真心也是工具：它讓羅馬的干預看起來像贈禮而非掠奪，同時把新附庸的忠誠綁在羅馬的戰車上。
causeEn: The causes of the war lie on several levels. The most immediate is the collapse of the truce: after the First Macedonian War Rome and Macedon had concluded a peace, but Philip had allied himself with Hannibal during the Second Punic War, and once Rome won at Zama in 202 BC the peace that had been sustained only because Rome needed to fight Carthage could not be kept; Rome resolved to end the eastern danger in one stroke while the memory of the recent war was still fresh. The second level is Philip's own expansion: after taking the throne in 221 BC he first suppressed the Paeonian revolt, then fought the Aetolian League from 220 to 217 BC, extended his grip into Epirus and the Peloponnese, and meddled in the politics of the Greek cities by grants of land and by propped-up clients, which made him a common enemy to both the Achaeans and the Aetolians. The third level is the plea from Greece: around 201 BC envoys of the Aetolian and Achaean leagues came to Rome in turn and laid out Philip's menace; Rome hesitated at first, and it was Flamininus's speech that turned opinion. The fourth level is Roman strategy itself: with the war against Carthage over, the mass of citizen infantry and the pool of experienced commanders needed a new theatre, and intervention in Greece let Rome take a moral position as a liberator rather than an aggressor. As for the slogan of a liberated Greece, it was both sincere and instrumental: it made Roman intervention look like a gift rather than a grab, while binding the loyalty of the new clients to the Roman war machine.
impact: 這場戰爭的餘波遠比戰役本身長。前196年弗拉米尼努斯在科林斯地峽宣布希臘各邦自由，亞該亞聯盟成為羅馬在希臘的執行者，埃托利亞聯盟則因分不到好處而心存怨懼；此後幾十年，羅馬以「仲裁者」身份介入城邦糾紛，最終把原來的同盟者變成了對手，公元前146年科林斯陷落、希臘各邦的最後一點自治被抹去，這條路正是從第二次馬其頓戰爭的勝利走上去的。對馬其頓而言，犬首山損失的不只是幾千人：方陣的精銳被俘、被殺，補充不易，菲利普退回本土，此後再也沒有能力支配希臘，只能在羅馬默許的範圍內重建國力，並把目光轉向安條克三世的塞琉古，試圖以聯手對抗羅馬。武器與戰術的層面，這場戰爭確立了破解希臘方陣的兩條辦法：側翼投射與集中騎兵衝擊；從此羅馬的兵制裡長期保留一支由同盟與外族組成的投射部隊與輕騎，同時說明公民兵之外的火力可以由別人替你帶來。戰爭也把羅馬的注意力從西地中海引向東地中海，馬其頓、塞琉古、埃及先後成了羅馬必須處理的對象。
impactEn: The consequences of this war outlasted the campaign itself. In 196 BC Flamininus proclaimed the freedom of the Greek cities at the Isthmus of Corinth; the Achaean League became the executor of Roman policy in Greece, while the Aetolian League, disappointed of its share, nursed a grudge. For decades afterwards Rome intervened in the quarrels of the cities as arbitrator, and gradually turned its former allies into its adversaries; the fall of Corinth in 146 BC, which ended the last remnant of Greek autonomy, lay on a road that began with the victory in the Second Macedonian War. For Macedon the cost of Cynoscephalae was not merely a few thousand men: the elite of the phalanx were killed or taken prisoner and could not easily be replaced, and Philip withdrew to his own borders, never again able to dominate Greece, able only to rebuild his strength within the bounds Rome permitted while turning his eyes towards Antiochus III of Syria and seeking a combination against Rome. At the level of arms and tactics, the war established the two answers to the Greek phalanx: missile fire on the flank and concentrated cavalry charge; from then on the Roman army kept a standing force of allied and foreign missile troops and light horse, which also demonstrated that firepower could be bought in from others while the citizen levy stayed at its own task. The war also swung Roman attention from the western Mediterranean to the eastern, and Macedon, Seleucid Syria and Egypt all became problems Rome had to handle.
result: 公元前197年，犬首山方陣崩潰，菲利普退回馬其頓本土，希臘諸邦的聯盟瓦解。公元前196年，弗拉米尼努斯在科林斯地峽宣布自由，羅馬隨即撤出希臘大部分駐軍，只在德米特里亞斯、科林斯與卡爾基斯留下少數守軍；公元前194年他卸任返羅馬，戰區交給西庇阿兄弟接管，隨後又轉給弗拉米尼烏斯的對手弗拉維烏斯·弗拉米尼努斯以外的一批將領。菲利普在和約中退出希臘、不得干涉亞該亞，並在十年內付出一千塔蘭特；希臘的城邦獲得形式上的自主，實則進入羅馬的盟邦秩序。埃托利亞聯盟表面上服從、內心不滿，終於在公元前146年與羅馬在亞該亞戰爭中正面衝突。馬其頓則在本土再聚力量，公元前192年加入安條克三世的聯盟對抗羅馬，最終在公元前168年被羅馬徹底解決。回頭看，這場戰爭是羅馬第一次以解放者的姿態踏足希臘本土，也是它從西地中海走向東地中海的起點。
resultEn: In 197 BC the phalanx broke at Cynoscephalae, Philip withdrew to Macedon proper, and the league of Greek cities fell apart. In 196 BC Flamininus proclaimed the freedom of the cities at the Isthmus of Corinth, and Rome withdrew most of its garrisons from Greece, keeping only small detachments at Demetrias, Corinth and Chalcis; in 194 BC he left for Rome and the theatre passed to the Scipios and then to another group of commanders. Under the settlement Philip withdrew from Greece, undertook not to interfere with the Achaean League, and agreed to pay a thousand talents over ten years; the Greek cities gained autonomy in form and entered the Roman alliance order in substance. The Aetolian League obeyed on the surface and resented it inwardly, and it came to open conflict with Rome in the Achaean War of 146 BC. Macedon rebuilt its strength at home, joined Antiochus III against Rome in 192 BC, and was finally settled by Rome in 168 BC. Looking back, this was the first time Rome set foot on Greek soil as a liberator, and the beginning of its move from the western Mediterranean towards the eastern.
